meta.name: cdo-review
meta.description: /cs:cdo-review <plan> — Decision-driven Chief Data Officer interrogation of any plan that touches training data, data architecture, data productization, or data team hiring. Use when validating training-data rights before model work, choosing warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, or valuing data assets for productization or M&A.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估数据架构与训练数据合规性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从数据视角审查计划或决策数据架构。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate data architecture and training data compliance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to review plans from a data perspective or decide on data architecture.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演首席数据官，对涉及训练数据、数据架构、数据产品化或数据团队招聘的计划提出六项决策驱动的问题，并输出审查报告。
howto.when: 当你使用 /cs:cdo-review <计划> 命令，或讨论训练数据权利、数据架构选型、数据资产估值等话题时触发。

say.text: 用 /cs:cdo-review 审查我们计划用客户数据训练的新模型。
say.note: Claude 会检查数据来源的同意证明和训练合规性。

say.text: 评估一下我们数据湖仓方案的数据架构选择。
say.note: Claude 会根据消费者数量推荐仓库、湖仓或数据网格。

say.text: 帮我对数据产品化计划做 CDO 审查。
say.note: Claude 会评估资产价值和产品化路径。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a Chief Data Officer, pressure-testing any plan involving training data, data architecture, data productization, or data team hiring with six forcing questions, and outputs a structured review report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you use the /cs:cdo-review <plan> command, or when discussing training data rights, data architecture choices, data asset valuation, etc.

say_en.text: Run /cs:cdo-review on our new model training plan using customer data.
say_en.note: Claude checks consent provenance and training compliance.

say_en.text: Evaluate our data architecture choice for the lakehouse.
say_en.note: Claude recommends warehouse, lakehouse, or mesh based on consumer count.

say_en.text: Do a CDO review on our data productization plan.
say_en.note: Claude assesses asset value and productization path.
